description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseAttribute' for attribute entities within the OpenMRS project. It includes fields for owner, attribute type, value reference, and value, along with methods for accessing and mutating these properties. It also implements comparison logic for attribute ordering. The class is annotated for persistence, auditing, and full-text search indexing.

classes.name: BaseAttribute
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a generic attribute with support for persistence, value handling, and comparison, intended to be extended by specific attribute implementations.

methods.name: getOwner
methods.description: Returns the owner of the attribute.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Sets the owner of the attribute.

methods.name: getDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the attribute type, used as a descriptor.

methods.name: getValueReference
methods.description: Returns the value reference string; throws if not persisted.

methods.name: setValueReferenceInternal
methods.description: Sets the internal value reference string and marks the attribute as not dirty.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the actual value, converting from the reference string if necessary.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the attribute's value and marks it as dirty.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Indicates whether the attribute has been modified since last persistence.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this attribute to another for ordering, based on voided status, attribute type, value reference, and ID.
